rationale: The agent failed to meet the user's request because they did not provide an actionable option for the user when the cheapest mechanical keyboard exceeded their budget. The agent should have offered to return or exchange the current keyboard as per the request once it was confirmed that the new one was unavailable under the budget. Instead, the agent only stated the price and asked if the user wanted more details or to explore other product categories without fulfilling the user's request for an exchange or return.
